notes: Test format, from the official notice: Wednesday 9 September 2026, 6.15pm, 1 hour, in person on supplied paper, worth 15% of the final mark. Calculators not permitted; no cheat sheet. Scope per the notice is all material to the end of Week 4 — the whole Finite State Automata section, and Turing machines up to and including Turing Computability — i.e. exactly FSA1-FSA6 and TM1-TM2, which is what this pack covers. Because no calculator is allowed, every computation drill is integer-valued and hand-doable; the largest answer any range can produce is 625. The app's Mock test timer is hardcoded to 30 minutes in src/views/SessionView.tsx (MOCK_MINUTES) and is not a per-pack setting, so a mock run is half the length of the real test.
emphasis: balanced — drills, definitions/theorem statements, and conceptual questions roughly evenly
longExamples: staged — multi-step procedures (state elimination, subset construction) are asked one stage at a time so a wrong answer localises which step of the method broke
